behavior.description: A knowledgeable player following the authored route with the intended gear, upgrades and rune counters.

fights.interpretation: A fight is contiguous engagement; target switches inside the grace stay one fight. End HP is the fraction at the last engaged sample (0 on death). Time in band is engaged time with HP in [low, high] over all engaged time. Boss fights are included when they happen in the sampled node; filter by biome for open-node evidence.
